name: Spicy Vietnamese-Style Pork Meatballs with Broccoli Slaw & Peanuts

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ small pkgs fresh mint
1 ½ small bunches cilantro
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a small bowl. Add soy sauce, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and cornstarch; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp fish sauce
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a large bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add pork, eggs, bread crumbs, fish sauce, and spices to the bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground pork
3 eggs
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp fish sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp onion powder
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the pork mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Transfer to a clean plate.
Separate the lettuce into leaves and roughly chop or tear into bite-size pieces; add to the plate with the cucumber.
When the meatballs are done, add sauce to the skillet and turn to coat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens slightly and coats meatballs, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide cucumbers, lettuce, and broccoli slaw between bowls. Top with saucy meatballs and sprinkle with peanuts. Enjoy!
